name: KBS India Limited
about: KBS India Limited provide brokerage services in India. The company provides share market brokers and investment in capital markets activities. It also offers equity broking, equity derivatives, IPO & buyback, depository services (CDSL), and SLBM. The company was formerly known as KBS Capital Management Ltd. and changed its name to KBS India Limited in March 2011. KBS India Limited was founded in 1935 and is based in Mumbai, India.
